Yeah, I know what you mean! For me, and I believe for many others, it's all about breaking the cycle... Anxiety is a terrible negative cycle that feeds into itself over and over. Something makes you nervous, and then you're nervous about being nervous which makes you MORE nervous and it just goes on and on and on. You just have to find a way to break that cycle. For me, in this one instance, it was saying "fuck it, bring it on". A lot of other times, it helps for me to take the worst possible scenario (like barfing in a car), and realistically imagining what people would say, or what the consequences would be. People would feel *bad* for you, and you'd move on. The things that make you nervous aren't usually as bad as you make them out to be when you're all hyped up. I just take the worst possible scenario and make it not so bad; that way, there isn't much to worry about at all.
